eligibility_note: Chosen development thresholds, not statistical guarantees. Require active focus, finite anchor logits and editable rows. Return is a stress test.
walltime_note: Estimates are admission checks against the actual Slurm EndTime, not an extra compute budget. Recheck before every gate, prefill and probe; use measured timings when larger.
scope: SC only, first canvas, original batch/seed. New-session replication keeps its own baseline. No full-response benchmark accuracy. No replacement of ineligible configurations.
